label: current

sac_workload.sampling_note: Fixed stratified stress sample plus one prefix anchor per object; not an unbiased replay estimate.

initial_state_preparation.note: Optimizer slots are created by actual gradients. Parameters unused by these samples may still have lazy slots.

config.status: candidate discounted-control baseline; independent scenario windows; technical readiness does not authorize a research run

task.control_telemetry: synchronous causal full service reports; overhead uncharged, as explicit idealized assumption

objective.discount_status: Candidate baseline, not an optimum or performance acceptance: gamma_micro 0.99 per 0.5 s, gamma_macro = 0.99**10 per 5 s; half-life ~34.5 s. PPO uses discounted within-macro learning reward; evaluation uses undiscounted physical costs.

information.history_training: full_prefix_recomputation_and_full_BPTT_of_observed_arrivals; no cached old learned hidden states

randomness.stream_schedules: explicitly specified in section17; CPU Dirichlet uses fork_rng and persistent dedicated states

research.note: Technical configuration confirmations are not authorization to launch research training. Each 900 s window resets to an independent scenario and ends by truncation with a real successor from the pre-reset trajectory; no cross-window physical checkpoint is needed. Gamma/lambda are candidate baseline values, not claimed optimal or performance-accepted. Schedule and network numbers unchanged.

methodology: Restore exact weights/optimizer/counters/RNG before every repetition; setup is excluded. Wall-clock runs have no cProfile or record_function wrappers; CUDA synchronization only at operation boundaries. RSS peak is sampled at 10 ms, so narrow peaks can be missed. Graph preparation includes Python building and transfers; identify actual copies using aten::_to_copy/copy_ and CUDA memcpy events, not the entire preparation scope.
limitations: Four replay objects and five PPO objects reuse these trajectories.
Normal/backlog mean empirical queue-count percentile bands, not configured arrival regimes.
Fresh initial state has lazy Adam slots; timings include their first allocation unless an initialized state is supplied.
PPO is a synthetic update workload on scripted states, not an on-policy rollout.
Evaluation replay does not execute chosen actions and cannot measure closed-loop cost or physics time.
Checkpoint uses two actual replay episodes; no claim about a full 55-episode buffer.
